text:
marie (infra): Heads-up — we're doing a coordinated GitHub org consolidation + Jira SSO cutover next week (Wed 2025-09-03 02:00 UTC). This affects repo org names, OAuth apps, and Jira project links. Please read the runbook and follow the pre-cutover checklist: https://ourdocs.internal/runbooks/gh-jira-cutover

kevin (eng): Ack. What exactly do engineers need to do? Any action on personal forks or remotes?

marie (infra): Short version: 1) Stop creating new repos in the old org after the freeze starts (01:30 UTC). 2) Update remotes for any local clones once cutover completes. 3) Recreate any personal app integrations that rely on the old org domain. We'll migrate forks where possible but personal forks may need manual re-pointing. Full checklist in the runbook. :memo:

sophia (devex): Will CI tokens/runner registrations break? Do we need to rotate any secrets?

marie (infra): Yes, CI provider will see repos move. We're rotating the GHA runner registration tokens and creating new repo-level secrets in the new org automatically for managed repos. For self-managed repos or manual secrets, you'll have to re-add them. We'll post a list of repos that require manual intervention ~2 hours before the cutover.

kevin (eng): For the record, a quick git snippet to update remotes: 
```
# replace OLDORG/REPO -> NEWORG/REPO
git remote set-url origin git@github.com:NEWORG/REPO.git
```
Will that be valid for forks too?

marie (infra): That works for forks you own. If your fork was under OLDORG (org-owned fork), we'll attempt to transfer it to NEWORG but if ownership conflicts exist you'll get an email to accept.

diana (oncall): What kind of downtime/lock will there be for PRs? We need to notify customers and dependent services.

marie (infra): Plan is a 15-minute read-only window for the old org (01:45-02:00 UTC) while we switch DNS/metadata and update webhooks. PR creation/commenting will be blocked; existing CI jobs will be queued then re-triggered in the new org. We will set status notifications to explain 'migration in progress' during the window.

ben (product): Are there any Jira tickets exchanges to be aware of? Links will break for embedded issues in docs and Notion — will redirects be created?

marie (infra): We'll be preserving issue keys and project keys. Links that include the old org domain will redirect for 30 days at the web layer, but embedded links in external systems (Notion pages) might need manual update for canonical display. We're exporting a mapping CSV so product can bulk-replace links if needed.

kevin (eng): Who do I ping if my deploys fail after the cutover?

diana (oncall): @diana (oncall) is taking primary oncall for the migration window. Use #release-war-room for escalation, and the oncall pager will be notified automatically.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: GitHub org consolidation starting 2025-09-03 01:30 UTC. Expected read-only window 01:45-02:00 UTC. See runbook: https://ourdocs.internal/runbooks/gh-jira-cutover

ops-bot: Automated preflight checks: 18/20 passed. Failing checks: 1) svc-account-gh-mirror missing key, 2) jira-webhook-app verification TTL. Both assigned to @marie (infra).

marie (infra): Thanks ops-bot — I'll fix the mirror key by EOD today. If you have custom OAuth apps (e.g., CI integrations, analytics bots), please add them to the migration spreadsheet so we can whitelist and migrate them automatically.

sophia (devex): Timeline note for SDKs & docs: we'll need to update example repo URLs in docs and the quickstart templates. I'll prepare a PR that can be merged after cutover to avoid CI churn. :books:

kevin (eng): One more Q: will Commit SHA references change? We reference raw file URLs in some internal pipelines.

marie (infra): Commit SHAs won't change, but raw URL domains will. We'll publish a mapping and a short proxy rule for raw content for 7 days. If you have pinned raw URLs in production, please queue updates now.

ben (product): Thanks — can we get a customer-facing message template?

marie (infra): Yep — product and customer-comms, I'll DM a template and post it in #customer-success by EOD.

kevin (eng): I'll add the 'update remotes' step to my team's oncall handover.

diana (oncall): I'll be online for the window and will post status updates in #release-war-room. If you want a quick pre-check with your repo owner, drop the repo name here and I'll confirm whether it's auto-migrated.

marie (infra): Final note: if you rely on third-party apps (Snyk, Dependabot, codecov), check their integration docs — some need re-authorization when org changes. We have a list in the runbook. Thanks everyone, appreciate the help to keep this smooth. :rocket:
